root_idea.summary: The root centers on movement, agitation, and trembling.
root_idea.development: From the basic idea of motion and disturbance, the root develops into thunder and the trembling it causes, as well as figurative threatening speech and several extensions describing quivering or shaken things.

senses.definition: Thunder: the sound associated with clouds or the sky.
senses.usage_conditions: The direct Quranic contextual use denotes the audible phenomenon of thunder.

senses.definition: The angel understood in a reported interpretation as driving the clouds.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a reported interpretation of the Quranic term alongside the direct sense “thunder,” not an interpretation that must replace the meteorological sense in every occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To thunder, of the sky or clouds; to produce the sound heard before rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often occurs with lightning in descriptions of a stormy sky.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To threaten, menace, frighten, or terrify.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of threats by speech and in the paired expression رَعَدَ وَبَرَقَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To beautify, adorn, and display oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression applied to a woman who intentionally exhibits her beauty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be assailed or affected by thunder; also, to hear thunder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may describe a person or group affected by thunder or the experience of hearing it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone or something to tremble, quiver, quake, shiver, or be agitated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cause may be fear, cold, or a comparable condition producing trembling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shake and consequently pour down, said of a hill or heap of sand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a mass whose shaking results in its material cascading downward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tremble, quiver, quake, shiver, or be in a state of commotion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially from fear or cold, though the construction can describe anything subject to such motion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be importunate in asking or begging.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intensive or repeated-form usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: War or calamity, in the expression جَاءَ بِذَاتِ الرَّعْدِ وَالصَّلِيلِ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression for bringing war, an attack, or a calamity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Threatening words or menacing language.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively of the contents of a letter or other speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tremor, quivering, quaking, shivering, or commotion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Typically occasioned by fear or cold, without being restricted to one particular physical object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cowardly; one who trembles or quakes from fear, especially in fighting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related feminine form may be applied to a woman in the same general characterization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Soft or tender, with flesh or substance that quivers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied particularly to a woman or girl, and also to a soft or tender plant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Quivering or shaking; used for the quivering sweet called فالوذ and for a hill or heap of sand that shakes and pours down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are conventional extensions describing characteristic quivering or shaken movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The material discarded from wheat during picking or cleansing, such as weed or other refuse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural term; an alternative spelling is reported, but رُعَيْدَاءُ is the preferred form in the cited evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thundering repeatedly or intensely, said of a cloud.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is reported with lexical disagreement about its attestation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Loquacious or excessively talkative, said of a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from repeated or abundant sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain electric fish that causes numbness and uncontrollable trembling when touched.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is applied to the fish because of the trembling and numbness it induces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thundering, said of a cloud.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used in the feminine form رَاعِدَةٌ for a thundering cloud.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A display of abundant talk, threat, or self-praise without corresponding substance or action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The proverb may describe a talkative person lacking good, one who claims deeds not performed, one who threatens without acting, or related forms of boastful unproductiveness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Importunate in asking or begging.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived descriptive form for the person characterized by persistent asking.
